objective: Qualify the frozen TOPO_RPAR scalar interaction coordinate unchanged on a fresh complete carrier whose frontier-relative depth range extends beyond every demanding derivation carrier.

selectionBasis: extends the demanding 4x4-k4 family by one gravity layer
directly tests the frozen TOPO_RPAR identifications depth 2~4 and depth 1~3

frozenCandidate.name: TOPO_RPAR
frozenCandidate.definition: Canonical owner-preserving residual/column incidence hypergraph with each residual cell labeled F when depth=0, O when depth is positive odd, and E when depth is positive even.

frozenFromPrior: exact-rank affine offset plus exact component-type parity
antiCircularity: The holdout geometry is fixed before its W/D/L qualification is observed.
TOPO_RPAR is copied unchanged from EW-RS-042.
No outcome, contradiction, fitted coefficient, or oracle label may alter the candidate during this holdout.
Solved outcomes appear only as qualification right-hand sides.
falsifiers: Any TOPO_RPAR scalar contradiction rejects the frozen candidate on 4x5-k4.
Any EXACT quadratic contradiction rejects degree-2 exact-component sufficiency on this holdout and must be separated from TOPO_RPAR failure.
If DEGREE1 has zero contradictions, 4x5-k4 is an affine control and does not establish necessity of the interaction correction.
If REL_INC fails while EXACT passes, frontier-relative exact incidence itself fails to transfer to this holdout.
successCriterion: TOPO_RPAR has zero scalar contradictions; for this run to count as a fresh non-affine holdout, DEGREE1 must also have at least one contradiction.
nextIfSuccess: Freeze the holdout result, then derive the two scalar syndrome bits directly in the frozen TOPO_RPAR coordinate without treating fitted gauge coefficients as invariant.
nextIfFail: Freeze the falsifier and refine only the frontier-relative topology/timing distinction exposed by the holdout; do not outcome-select arbitrary component IDs or absolute elevation.
